translation_snapshot.source: learn how to build this tinker
Provides a frost aura, giving you +%d%% blight, mind and acid affinity.
translation_snapshot.target: 提供静水光环，使你获得 +%d%% 枯萎、精神和酸性伤害亲和。

translation_snapshot.source:
Trigger an array of small mirrors to appear all over your cloak.
		The mirrors are positioned to reflect all light shining on you, granting %d stealth power for 10 turns.
		Stealth power increases with your steampower.
translation_snapshot.target:
在披风上布满细小的反射镜阵列，反射照射到你身上的所有光线，让你直接潜形。
		获得 %d 潜行强度，持续 10 回合。
		潜行强度受蒸汽强度加成。

translation_snapshot.source: (This note had already caught fire when the paradox anomaly pulled it in from another timeline.  You only had time to read part of the title before it burned away completely.)
translation_snapshot.target: （当时空异常从另一条世界线拉入这条纸条的时候，这张纸条突然着火了。你还没来得及看完标题，这张纸条已经被烧得一干二净。）

translation_snapshot.source: %d%% chance to fully absorb any damaging actions, %d stealth value.
translation_snapshot.target: %d%% 几率吸收伤害，%d 潜行强度。

translation_snapshot.source: "Have you ever fired a shot into a group of monsters and thought 'there must be a better way?' Well now, there is!"
translation_snapshot.target: 你曾经试过向一群怪兽中发射一粒粒弹药，然后觉得一定有更好的方法？好了，这就是了。

translation_snapshot.source: Supercharge your thinking and give your brain a boost with the Mental Stimulator!
translation_snapshot.target: 强化你的思考能力，加速你的大脑！

translation_snapshot.source: Storing damage to unleash as a powerful lightning bolt (%d/%d).
translation_snapshot.target: 已格挡伤害可累积至上限，准备放出强力闪电（%d/%d）。
